Fast, open source test selection. brisk reads your project's import graph and runs only the tests your change touches, so
CI takes seconds instead of minutes.
brisk builds an import graph of your project once and caches it.
Each run finds the files your change touched and walks the graph to every test that imports them.
It hands those tests to your runner: Vitest, Jest, pytest, or cargo test.
brisk is open source under the MIT license. Contributions are welcome: start with CONTRIBUTING.md .
